subject: Quarter-final evidence sprint and closure roadmap
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>; Jordan Mills <jordan@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics SOC <security@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter-final evidence sprint and closure roadmap

Team / Jordan —

Quick update and ask as we head into the final scoring window for Q1: the product and security evidence sprint (requested by Acme) lands this week and we need leadership sign-off on a small set of adjudications before we publish final OKR grades. High-level plan below: 

- Thu 4/15: internal triage of outstanding evidence (attachments include raw evidence pack + a one-page closure playbook).
- Fri 4/16: leadership handback — Kimberly & Vivek to record final adjudications for contested items.
- Mon 4/19: publish scorecards and send customer-facing wrap.

Asks: 
1) Laura — can you run the triage call Thursday 10:30–11:15 PT and confirm attendance? I flagged the top 12 contested vignettes in the spreadsheet.
2) Marissa — please prepare a short narrative (200–300 words) we can paste into the customer email explaining the adjudication logic for the two contested infrastructure OKRs.
3) Vivek — I will need your quick sign-off Friday afternoon on the four items I highlighted; if we need to escalate, call me and I’ll bring it into exec office hours.

Jordan — thanks for being available on short notice. We’ll include a redacted evidence package for your internal SOC review by EOD Thu. If Acme needs a separate attestation note for procurement, flag it here.

Attachments: OKR-evidence-pack-2027Q1.zip (evidence index + redactions), score-annotations-2027Q1.xlsx (contested-vignette tab), closure-playbook-v1.pdf (timings & comms template)

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Mills <jordan@acme-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics SOC <security@acme-analytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 07:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter-final evidence sprint and closure roadmap

Thanks Kimberly — we appreciate the timeline and the attachments. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- Acme SOC has a short checklist; we should be able to return a redacted confirmation by end of day Friday once we get the evidence pack.
- For procurement, we will need a one-paragraph attestation that no customer data was used in the benchmarking artifacts (can be a short sentence in the final customer email).

I will be on the triage call Thursday — sending calendar invite now. If anything changes, I’ll ping Laura directly.

—Jordan
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics

1) Quick walkthrough of contested vignettes (10 min)
2) Evidence gaps and mitigations (10 min)
3) Handback timing and final owner assignments (10 min)

I've pre-tagged the 12 vignettes into A/B/C priority in the spreadsheet. Please review tab "contested-vignette" before the call; Marissa, aim to drop your narrative into the doc by EOD Thu so Jordan and SOC can see wording. 

Laura Bennett

Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter-final evidence sprint and closure roadmap

Attached a 220-word narrative (tab 'customer-narrative' in the spreadsheet) focused on rationalizing the two infra OKR adjustments. Key points I used:

- Evidence did show operational improvements but lacked consistent load-profile tests across three regions; partial credit for reliability OKR, full credit for observability.
- We documented compensating controls (caching safeguards + circuit-breaker rollout) and cited patch dates.

I also dropped a short optional attestation sentence you can use for procurement: "Redwood did not use customer PII or customer production data in the benchmarking artifacts; all tests were run on synthetic or internal-owned datasets."

Link to updated spreadsheet in Drive.

Marissa Cole
Product Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quarter-final evidence sprint and closure roadmap (final adjudications recorded)

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. I reviewed the contested items and recorded final adjudications in the score-annotations sheet (column 'lead-signoff'). Summary: 

- Infrastructure reliability: adjusted to 75% (partial credit) with mitigation milestones assigned.
- Observability: full credit maintained.
- Security control evidence: accepted per SOC review — Jordan, thanks for the confirmation.

Kimberly — please proceed with publishing the updated scorecards and the customer email. Marissa, please stitch the short narrative into the customer-facing blurb and include the procurement attestation if Acme confirmed that they needed one.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform & Operations
Redwood Inference
